logic.bm: Electrification business area: LV circuit breakers & switches (Emax/Tmax air & molded-case), MV switchgear/breakers & secondary distribution, busway & power distribution, power quality & protection, installation products (Thomas & Betts), building automation, Electrification Service. ABB no longer makes power/distribution transformers since the Power Grids sale to Hitachi (2020) — exposure to Sanil is via the same US data-center/utility/building power-distribution capex cycle rather than transformers. Segment description (Q4 2025 FI): 'manufactures and sells electrical products and solutions which are designed to provide the efficient and reliable distribution of electricity from source to socket'.
logic.recognition: 제품 출하·고객 검수 또는 프로젝트 진행률의 회사 공시 기준을 대사. 수주액·수주잔고·수출통계는 매출과 별도.
logic.bridge: 이미 인식한 누적 매출 + 납기별 기초 수주잔고 전환 + 당기 수주 중 인도 가능한 물량. 생산능력·취소·검수·환율을 별도 가정.

structural_breaks.note: EV charging, solar (inverters) and power quality businesses transferred from Discrete Automation & Motion into Electrification Products; Q1 2016 EP recast (revenue 2,125→2,289, orders 2,327→2,506). 2016 points keep as-reported values; 2017 points carry recast prior-year comparatives.
Remaining EPC businesses moved to a non-core unit in Corporate and Other; previously reported amounts reclassified (EP unaffected materially).

GE Industrial Solutions (GEIS) acquired and consolidated in Electrification Products from Q3 2018 (EP revenue Q3 2018 3,199 vs 2,596). Not recast — use prior_year_comparative/comparable growth for like-for-like.

Power Grids moved to discontinued operations (sale of 80.1% to Hitachi announced 2018-12-17; closed 2020-07-01). Group revenue from Q4 2018 excludes Power Grids and prior periods restated. Power Grids was never part of Electrification (Products).

Electrification Products segment renamed Electrification (four business areas: Electrification, Industrial Automation, Motion, Robotics & Discrete Automation). Comparatives unchanged for Electrification.
Electrification completed divestment of solar inverter business to FIMER (not restated).
Power Grids divestment (80.1% to Hitachi) completed; already in discontinued operations since Q4 2018.
E-mobility moved out of Electrification into Corporate and Other; Q1–Q4 2022 Electrification comparatives recast (e.g., Q1 2022 orders 4,397→4,112, revenues 3,327→3,236).
Power Conversion division (part of Electrification) sold to AcBel Polytech (~$500m); closing announced 2023-07-03 (not restated).

Robotics division agreed for sale (SoftBank) and reported as discontinued ops; business areas become Electrification, Motion, Automation. Group revenue comparatives recast from Q4 2025; Electrification unaffected.
